Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_00.001.zh-Hans: 马桶堵住了然后上涌……有点味道的想法
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_00.001.en: The toilet clogged and overflowed… a rather fragrant idea.
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_00.001.zh-Hant: 馬桶堵住了然後上湧……有點味道的想法

Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_01.001.zh-Hans: 蚂蚁一直挖掘 涌现出了复杂的通路
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_01.001.en: The ants keep digging, and complex paths emerge.
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_01.001.zh-Hant: 螞蟻一直挖掘，湧現出了複雜的通路

Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_02.001.zh-Hans: 化学元素通过反应产生新的物质 进而形成大千世界
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_02.001.en: Elements react to form new substances—and, eventually, a whole world.
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_02.001.zh-Hant: 化學元素透過反應產生新的物質，進而形成大千世界

Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_03.001.zh-Hans: 肉鸽游戏很适合做连携 算是"1+1>2"的涌现吧
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_03.001.en: Roguelikes are great for combos. A kind of “1 + 1 > 2” emergence, I suppose.
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_03.001.zh-Hant: 肉鴿遊戲很適合做連攜，算是「1+1>2」的湧現吧

Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_04.001.zh-Hans: “1+1>2” 从这个点出发想想“涌现”吧
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_04.001.en: “1 + 1 > 2.” Maybe that's a way to think about emergence.

Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_05.001.zh-Hans: 把磁带扯出来……这算一种涌现吗
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_05.001.en: Pull the tape out… does that count as emergence?
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_05.001.zh-Hant: 把磁帶扯出來……這算一種湧現嗎

Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_06.001.zh-Hans: 简单的几个音符能涌现出复杂的旋律
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_06.001.en: Complex melodies can emerge from just a few simple notes.
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_06.001.zh-Hant: 簡單的幾個音符能湧現出複雜的旋律

Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_07.001.zh-Hans: 回忆涌上心头……这也是一种涌现
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_07.001.en: Memories come flooding back… that's a kind of emergence, too.
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_07.001.zh-Hant: 回憶湧上心頭……這也是一種湧現

Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_08.001.zh-Hans: 将曼妥思投入可乐的话 可乐就会“涌现”出来
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_08.001.en: Drop Mentos into cola, and the cola comes “emerging” out.
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_08.001.zh-Hant: 將曼妥思投入可樂，可樂就會「湧現」出來

Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_09.001.zh-Hans: AI的思考不断涌现 就如同不断向下延伸的根
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_09.001.en: AI thoughts keep emerging, like roots reaching ever deeper.
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_09.001.zh-Hant: AI 的思考不斷湧現，就如同不斷向下延伸的根

Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_10.001.zh-Hans: 萤火虫的同步闪烁：随机中怎样涌现出秩序？
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_10.001.en: Fireflies blinking in sync: how does order emerge from randomness?
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_10.001.zh-Hant: 螢火蟲的同步閃爍：隨機中怎樣湧現出秩序？

Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_11.001.zh-Hans: 大量的彩带喷涌而出 也很涌现
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_11.001.en: A shower of confetti bursting out. That feels like emergence, too.
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_11.001.zh-Hant: 大量的彩帶噴湧而出，也很湧現

Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_12.001.zh-Hans: 收集到了25个铜矿！灵感涌现！
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_12.001.zh-Hant: 收集到 25 個銅礦了！靈感湧現！

Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_13.001.zh-Hans: 收集到了15个铁矿！灵感涌现！
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_13.001.zh-Hant: 收集到 15 個鐵礦了！靈感湧現！

Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_14.001.zh-Hans: 收集到了10个孔雀石！灵感涌现！
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_14.001.zh-Hant: 收集到 10 個孔雀石了！靈感湧現！

Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_15.001.zh-Hans: 收集到了5个钻石！灵感涌现！
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_15.001.zh-Hant: 收集到 5 個鑽石了！靈感湧現！

Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_16.001.zh-Hans: 火候让食材涌现出新的香气 真香！
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_16.001.en: Heat brings new aromas out of the ingredients. Smells delicious!
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_16.001.zh-Hant: 火候讓食材湧現出新的香氣，真香！

Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_17.001.zh-Hans: 小小鱼缸里也有复杂生态
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_17.001.en: Even a tiny fish tank holds a complex ecosystem.
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_17.001.zh-Hant: 小小魚缸裡也有複雜生態

Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_19.001.zh-Hans: 几种滋味碰在一起 口感也有了新的层次
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_19.001.en: A few flavors meet, and new layers of taste emerge.
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_19.001.zh-Hant: 幾種滋味碰在一起，口感也有了新的層次

Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_20.001.zh-Hans: 一生二 二生三 三生万物……
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_20.001.en: One gives birth to two, two to three, and three to all things…
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_20.001.zh-Hant: 一生二，二生三，三生萬物……

Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_21.001.zh-Hans: 车门一开 人潮就涌出来了！
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_21.001.en: The doors open, and a crowd pours out!
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_21.001.zh-Hant: 車門一開，人潮就湧出來了！

Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_22.001.zh-Hans: 一句话很轻 无数句话堆在一起 却能改变世界 也能压垮一个人
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_22.001.en: One sentence weighs little. Countless words together can change the world—or crush a person.
Subtitle.CollectiblePickup_22.001.zh-Hant: 一句話很輕，無數句話堆在一起，卻能改變世界，也能壓垮一個人

Subtitle.Cards1.001.zh-Hans: 卡牌之间的连携可以打出强大的效果
Subtitle.Cards1.001.en: Combining cards can produce powerful effects.
Subtitle.Cards1.001.zh-Hant: 卡牌之間的連攜可以打出強大的效果

Subtitle.Cards1.002.zh-Hans: 比如元素之间的反应 涌现出新的效果
Subtitle.Cards1.002.en: Like elements reacting to create something new.
Subtitle.Cards1.002.zh-Hant: 比如元素之間的反應，湧現出新的效果

Subtitle.Cards2.001.zh-Hans: 这种卡牌玩法会不会太常见了呢？
Subtitle.Cards2.001.en: But isn't this kind of card game a little too familiar?
Subtitle.Cards2.001.zh-Hant: 這種卡牌玩法會不會太常見了呢？

Subtitle.CardsVictory.001.zh-Hans: *恭喜你获得钻机！按V可切换使用*
Subtitle.CardsVictory.001.en: *You got the drill! Press V to switch tools.*
Subtitle.CardsVictory.001.zh-Hant: *恭喜你獲得鑽機！按 V 可切換使用*

Subtitle.EchoMaze.001.zh-Hans: 通过敲击产生的声音 让前方的道路涌现出来
Subtitle.EchoMaze.001.en: The sound of your strikes makes the path ahead emerge.
Subtitle.EchoMaze.001.zh-Hant: 透過敲擊產生的聲音，讓前方的道路湧現出來

Subtitle.FirstCollectionHint.001.en: Press C to open your collection.
Subtitle.FirstCollectionHint.001.zh-Hant: 按 C 開啟收藏品介面吧

Subtitle.LeaveStartRoom.001.zh-Hans: 亮晶晶的地方说明一定有矿石 赶紧挖挖看
Subtitle.LeaveStartRoom.001.en: Those sparkling spots must hide minerals. Try digging!
Subtitle.LeaveStartRoom.001.zh-Hant: 亮晶晶的地方一定有礦石，趕緊挖挖看

Subtitle.Museum1.001.zh-Hans: 当你看到一个东西 一句话就会”涌现”在你的脑海里
Subtitle.Museum1.001.en: When you look at something, a sentence “emerges” in your mind.
Subtitle.Museum1.001.zh-Hant: 當你看到一個東西，一句話就會「湧現」在你的腦海裡

Subtitle.Museum1.002.zh-Hans: 如果有两个这样的东西 就可以交换他们的描述
Subtitle.Museum1.002.en: With two things in mind, you can swap their descriptions.
Subtitle.Museum1.002.zh-Hant: 如果有兩個這樣的東西，就可以交換它們的描述

Subtitle.Museum2.002.zh-Hans: 也许需要设计一个方法跳过这一部分
Subtitle.Museum2.002.en: Maybe there should be a way to skip this part.
Subtitle.Museum2.002.zh-Hant: 也許需要設計一個方法跳過這一部分

Subtitle.Museum2.003.zh-Hans: 比如长按P键持续3秒，就可以跳过这一关
Subtitle.Museum2.003.en: For example, hold P for three seconds to skip this puzzle.
Subtitle.Museum2.003.zh-Hant: 比如長按 P 鍵持續 3 秒，就可以跳過這一關

Subtitle.Museum3.001.zh-Hans: 真的不是很喜欢解谜啊 算了吧
Subtitle.Museum3.001.en: I really don't enjoy puzzles that much. Never mind.
Subtitle.Museum3.001.zh-Hant: 真的不是很喜歡解謎啊，算了吧

Subtitle.OfficeGameplay1.001.zh-Hans: 工作是一个能引发共鸣的话题
Subtitle.OfficeGameplay1.001.en: Work is something everyone can relate to.
Subtitle.OfficeGameplay1.001.zh-Hant: 工作是一個能引發共鳴的話題

Subtitle.OfficeGameplay1.002.zh-Hans: DDL不断从电脑和打印机里“涌现”出来
Subtitle.OfficeGameplay1.002.en: Deadlines keep “emerging” from the computer and printer.
Subtitle.OfficeGameplay1.002.zh-Hant: DDL 不斷從電腦和印表機裡「湧現」出來

Subtitle.OfficeGameplay1.003.en: And the player has to keep dealing with them…

Subtitle.OfficeGameplay2.001.en: This feels a little too exhausting.

Subtitle.PickaxeUpgrade1.001.zh-Hans: 矿镐升级可以让挖掘更轻松
Subtitle.PickaxeUpgrade1.001.en: Upgrading your pickaxe makes digging easier.
Subtitle.PickaxeUpgrade1.001.zh-Hant: 礦鎬升級可以讓挖掘更輕鬆

Subtitle.StartRoomBook.001.zh-Hans: 有新东西的话就记录下吧
Subtitle.StartRoomBook.001.en: Write down anything new you find.
Subtitle.StartRoomBook.001.zh-Hant: 有新東西就記錄下來吧
